children: American Water Works Company, Inc. (NYSE:AWK) bolstered liquidity with $500M of 5.55% notes due 2033 to refinance debt and fund loans, while expanding operations—buying Venice, IL wastewater system and opening a NW Indiana training center—and advancing its merger review with Essential Utilities via a joint settlement.
American Water Works Company, Inc. Notes Sold

: American Water (AWK) via AWCC sold $500M 5.55% senior notes due 2033, net proceeds ~$496.6M used to repay $250M maturing notes, fund regulated loans, cut commercial paper, and general corporate uses.
: American Water (AWK) filed a joint non‑unanimous settlement Sept 15, 2026 in PaPUC review of its proposed merger with Essential Utilities; ALJs will review and issue a recommended decision.
American Water Works Unit Buy Venice System
: American Water Works (AWK) Illinois unit bought Venice, IL wastewater system for $770,000, adding ~500 customers. ICC approved June 24, 2026. $2.6M planned capex over five years for upgrades.
American Water Works Training Center, Flow Forward
: American Water Works (AWK) opened a training center in Northwest Indiana and launched Flow Forward, a workforce program linking students to water, wastewater and engineering career pathways.
